main.summary: Represents a known object identity and certificate used by the `DataItem` security model.
main.remarks: This type is the neutral runtime representation of an object that can participate in `DataItem` protection, recipient selection, and assertion verification.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a new known security object from an object identifier and certificate.
constructor.param: Object identifier for the known object.
Certificate associated with the known object.
Optional descriptive display name for diagnostics or presentation.
constructor.returns: A new known security object value.

property.name: ObjectId
property.summary: Object identifier associated with the certificate.

property.name: Certificate
property.summary: Certificate associated with the known object.

property.name: Thumbprint
property.summary: Normalized thumbprint captured from the certificate.

property.name: DisplayName
property.summary: Optional human-readable name for the known object.
